messages:
shrey: Starting thread for tonight's v2 rollforward. Change window 2024-08-28T02:00Z. Please list any tenant holds or compatibility concerns now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by @shrey for 2024-08-28T02:00Z. Plan: 5% canary (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100% if green. Rollback triggers: global 5xxs > 1.5% OR p99 latency delta > 50% for 10m.

alyssa: Quick note: third-party integrators using legacy schema will send old 'payload_v' header and could hit parsing errors. We have ~0.9% of traffic with that header.

paul: I exported a hold list for known fragile tenants: s3://rwd-release/pins/fragile-tenants-2024-08-28.json (198 tenants).

shrey: Thanks. Two mitigation options: 1) route-split by header and keep legacy traffic on v1 shim; 2) pin tenants from the list. Which is less risky?

ops: If we can gate by header at the gateway that's lower blast radius. Route-split command:
```
rwdctl routes split --route /api/chat --by-header payload_v --mapping v1:legacy,v2:default
```
But header normalization must be correct.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2024-08-28T02:00Z. Traffic 5%. Observing baseline metrics.

alyssa: Already seeing a handful of parsing errors from legacy schema -> 400s but localized. Count ~120 in last 30s.

paul: I'm enabling header gate for /api/chat to send payload_v=old to v1. Applying now.

paul: Command:
```
rwdctl feature toggle --name header_gate_payload_v --on --scope route:/api/chat
```
Result: applied.

deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted per header gate. Canary continues at 5%.

shrey: Release note draft: "API v2 becomes default routing. Clients using legacy schema will be redirected to a compatibility shim when payload_v header is present. We strongly recommend migrating to new payload format. See migration guide: docs.rwd/migrate-payload" Review?

release-manager: Suggest add a known issue: "Clients behind older proxies may strip payload_v header; these clients will be treated as v2 and may get validation errors. If you see this, add the header or pin your tenant."

ops: Monitoring: live dashboard metrics.rwd/dash/v2-rollout, alerting on global 5xx and per-region p99. I set alert: legacy-parse-errors > 0.5% for 5m -> page.

deploy-bot: Canary moving to 25% at 02:15Z.

alyssa: Parse-error rate jumped to 0.9% and is concentrated in APAC region. p99 APAC increased 65%.

ops: Paging SRE. Recommend immediate containment: either pin APAC-heavy tenants or roll back the canary.

paul: Applying tenant pins for APAC-heavy list: pins/apac-heavy-2024-08-28.json
Command:
```
rwdctl pins add --route /api/chat --tenants-file pins/apac-heavy-2024-08-28.json --reason "apac perf and legacy-schema"
```
Result: 421 tenants pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by operator @paul at 2024-08-28T02:18Z. No further traffic increases.

shrey: Good containment. Do we want to continue with header-gate + pins and iterate on parser fallback, or prefer rollback?

alyssa: Parser team can deploy a soft-accept mode that accepts both schemas without strict validation. ETA ~40m. That might remove parsing 400s.

ops: If we can keep overall 5xxs < 0.5% and p99 delta < 30% we can avoid full rollback. Current global 5xx is 0.4% but APAC p99 still high.

release-manager: I'll mark the release tracker: "paused - targeted pins + header gate active; parser fallback in progress" and update release notes to call out the APAC issue and temporary tenant pins.

paul: Reminder: to revert pins after fix use:
```
rwdctl pins remove --file pins/apac-heavy-2024-08-28.json --route /api/chat
```

deploy-bot: Manual operator action recorded: header_gate enabled, pins applied, canary paused.

ops: SRE investigating APAC latency spike - initial hypothesis: older edge proxies adding extra TCP hop and causing slower upstream validation CPU spike. Collecting traces and CPU flamegraphs.

alyssa: I'll push a parser soft-accept candidate to staging now and run a subset of APAC replay. ETA 30m.

shrey: Action items: 1) alyssa parser soft-accept deployment and runbench (30m), 2) ops/SRE to finish traces and confirm root cause (15m), 3) release-manager to update customers and release notes. Decision criteria: if parser fix reduces APAC parse errors below 0.2% and p99 delta < 25% we resume rollout.

paul: Noted. Ill standby to remove pins once we get green.

shrey: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in 35m in this thread. Keep posts brief. :handshake:
